Class Configuration

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.memfs.Configuration
public final class Configuration extends Object
How a memory file system behaves: its path style, roots, working directory, capacity, name matching, attribute views, default attributes, clock and features. Configurations are immutable; toBuilder() starts a changed copy. 
Configuration small = Configuration.windows().toBuilder()
        .roots("C:\\", "D:\\")
        .maxSize(16 * 1024 * 1024)
        .currentUser("alice", "staff")
        .build();

Permissions are always stored. They are enforced only when a current user is configured: then the POSIX permissions of the posix view, the read-only flag of the dos view and the entries of a non-empty access control list of the acl view are checked against that user and their groups, and a denied operation throws AccessDeniedException. The user root is never denied.

Since:
0.1.1

    • newBuilder

      public static Configuration.Builder newBuilder(PathStyle style)
      Returns a builder that starts with the defaults of a path style: those of unix() or windows(). Every file system also has a block size of 8 KiB, a capacity of 4 GiB, names of 255 characters at most, the system clock, a watch service that polls every second, and every Feature.
      Parameters:
      style - the path style
      Returns:
      a new builder
